note: Actual export shipments are confirmed by dated Indian customs records, not by a website claim: B/L 8151549, 2025-12-23, Nhava Sheva Sea -> Ambarli (Turkey), buyer 'TO THE ORDER', auto spare parts. Note the declared HS set (392321;481910;848210;853950 — plastic bags/boxes, ball bearings, lamps) does NOT match the observed cargo (84133090 water pumps, 84213990 filters, 84834000 sprockets, 85111000 spark plugs, 85129000 wiper blades). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the observed codes and the verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Also note the claimed industry 'Строительство и DIY' (construction/DIY) conflicts with the observed auto-parts trade — the company reads as an auto-components trader/exporter, role likely trader or manufacturer_trader (not determinable from shipment data alone). Only 5 of the claimed 1122 rows were visible in the free view, so the full shipment history, revenue and export value remain null — not invented. Domestic (India) supply side is unverified: no GST turnover, tender or contract evidence obtained, so 'следов поставок не найдено' cannot be asserted for the domestic leg either; it is simply unknown.
